Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents a school subject with its associated details.

name.description: Name of the subject (e.g., Math, English).

room.description: The room where the subject is taught.

teacher.description: Name of the teacher for the subject.

isMainSubject.description: Indicates whether the subject is a main subject.

notes.description: Additional notes or information about the subject.

materialsLink.description: Link to online materials for the subject.

id.description: Unique identifier for the homework task.

dueDate.description: The due date for the task.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as done.

UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific application data like timetable and settings.

shareId.description: The user's unique and shareable ID (UID).

role.description: The user's role in the application.

groupId.description: The ID of the group the user belongs to.

groupSettings.description: User's settings related to their group membership.

syncTimetable.description: If true, user's timetable is synced with the group's.

showInGroup.description: If true, the user is visible to other group members.

shareHomework.description: If true, homework is shared with the group.

timetableSettings.description: Settings for the user's personal timetable.

notesSlots.description: 15 slots for personal notes in tools.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Represents a student group or class.

name.description: Name of the group or class.

motto.description: A fun motto for the group.

admin.description: The UID of the user who created and manages the group.

timetable.description: The shared timetable for the group.

timetableSettings.description: The shared timetable settings for the group.

members.description: A list of user UIDs who are members of this group.

QuickNote.title: Quick Note
QuickNote.description: A quick note created in the workspace.

content.description: The markdown content of the note.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the note.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the note was last updated.

isLocked.description: Indicates if the note is locked for editing.

TextDocument.title: Text Document
TextDocument.description: A rich-text document similar to a Word file.

content.description: The HTML content of the document.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the document.

isPublished.description: Whether the document is publicly accessible.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the document was last updated.

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: A quiz document consisting of multiple slides.

title.description: The title or theme of the quiz.

creator.description: The name of the quiz creator.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the quiz.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the quiz was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the quiz was last updated.

TodoItem.title: Todo Item
TodoItem.description: A single item in a to-do list.

id.description: Unique client-side generated ID for the item.

text.description: The content of the to-do item.

done.description: Whether the to-do item is completed.

dueDate.description: The due date for the item.

group.description: The group this task belongs to.

subtasks.description: A list of sub-tasks for this item.

title.description: The title of the to-do list.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the list.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the list was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the list was last updated.

settings.description: Settings for this specific to-do list.

definition.description: Stores user profile data. The userId is the document ID.
